definitions.explanation: A product that has been recently developed and released onto the market.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new product has been released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{新製品|しんせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Every year in autumn, there is a new product announcement event.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{新製品|しんせいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来品|じゅうらいひん}→従来品：23959_juuraihin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{三割|さんわり}⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: This new product is 30% lighter and easier to use than the previous model.

notes:
{新製品|しんせいひん} is a compound of {新|しん} (new) + ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (manufactured product). It refers to newly developed and released items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to release a new product
- {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: new product development
- {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧: product launch event
- {新製品|しんせいひん}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧: new product review

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧: new product (more from the seller/retail perspective)
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new model (often for cars, electronics)
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}モデル→最新モデル：26693_saishinmoderu⟧: latest model

USAGE:
Common in business, marketing, and consumer contexts. {新製品|しんせいひん} emphasizes that the item was manufactured/produced, while ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧ emphasizes it as something for sale.
